intent: Two people argue in a corridor; a third arrives and the argument stops.

shots.purpose: Establish that B is waiting and has already decided to confront A.
shots.content: 00:00-00:02 B walks toward camera from the far end of the corridor, hands out of pockets. 00:02-00:05 B stops one step short of frame, chin lifts.

spatial.motivation: B's walk supplies the approach; the camera stays put so the stop reads as a decision.

negative: no text or signage invented on the walls
no change in corridor length between frames
feet stay in contact with the floor

shots.purpose: Let A refuse the accusation without leaving the frame, so the refusal costs something.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: You said you would tell me first.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: I did tell you. You weren't listening.

shots.content: 00:00-00:03 over B's shoulder: A keeps their eyes on the floor, then lifts them on "weren't listening". 00:03-00:06 reverse over A's shoulder: B's jaw sets, no reply.

spatial.motivation: No move. The cut on the last word carries the pressure.

negative: no shoulder swap inside a single take
no face morph on the head lift
both speakers keep the same screen side across the cut

shots.purpose: Bring C into the argument as an authority neither A nor B expected, and kill the tension with their arrival.

anchors: A at frame left, back to the wall
B at frame right, facing A
C entering from the stairwell behind B
topDownMap.cameraRoute: lateral track right to left, starting behind the pillar at frame right
topDownMap.focusHandoff: A → C on the pillar clearing the frame

shots.content: 00:00-00:04 camera tracks left past the pillar; C is revealed standing still at the stairwell. 00:04-00:08 push in on A as A turns to C; B stays out of focus in the foreground.

spatial.motivation: C's stillness after the track is the trigger for the push.

negative: pillar must not clip through B
C does not walk during the reveal
no extra figures in the stairwell
B's position does not jump between the track and the push
